================================================================================
PHASE 11A: CORE LAMBDA LAWS (mandatory verification)
================================================================================
  Compression: 3 x-coordinates share one y^2; 2 y-branches (+/-) pick one Py/ry pair.
  y-side law is QUADRATIC (lambda^2). x-side collapse is CUBIC (Lambda^3).
  Do not mix layers: lambda_yN^2 != Lambda_N^3 in general (3 x vs 2 y symmetry).

  --- p-side (row 1, mod p) ---
  [152] lambda_y = Py1 * ry1^-1 mod p
       = 31799057404770875803837368541527197630530596248176682227737526444375588334396

       = OK
       note: REQUIRED PASS — 2 y-branches compress x

       = OK
